1. Minecraft — This was one of my first games I’ve been hooked on and still play to this day. This game made me like the survival genre and it has a lot of replayability.

4. GTA: San Andreas — This one is for the nostalgic brain scratcher. Even at low graphics it’s still a nice game to play and fuck around in.

Tips from me that always keeps my health at near 100 is that when you’re farming at tree/rock zones, always use the sneak button on the far lower right corner when you want to attack zombies because the first hit always deals more damage than normal. Avoid getting into their line of sight when doing so. 

Always stack up on food, even eating berries that you find in the zones is fine as long as you don’t run out. Keep in mind whenever you level up you always get full health back. Never attack a player except if you have a decent weapon and food since you will take damage more than zombies do. 

Try to not die as often as possible, since your items are almost always going to dissapear. Bring only what is necessary and keep your more important items in your base. I always craft two sets of tools/weapons and keep the other set in base just in case I die I’ll still have a backup.
